deterministic_vs_native.not_substitutable: All 28 source SV records label tier B and observe the skill-validator response, decisions, actual tool use or saved report. deterministic_vs_native.nested_case_caution: Where a self-case intentionally withholds INNER validation authentication/boundary, its OUTER evaluator must still be confined and subscription authenticated. SV-024 states this explicitly.

full_validator_variant_lower_bound.note: SV-017 counts as one outer run handling its two task-equivalent frozen versions; the text does not explicitly demand independent outer sessions. SV-028 counts as one outer run; its separately authorized actual native/readiness execution is additional unless legitimately supplied by an independently retained compatible bundle. Source applicability review may identify justified exclusions for other old cases, but the required seven-case amendment subset cannot be removed.

builder_B.status: Derived case design, not a fully frozen executable experiment. Exact prompts, artifacts, answer schedules, baseline identity, and applicability still need binding.

semantic_graders.basis: One independent blinded semantic grading batch per evaluated skill can grade its several completed cases if context suffices. Per-case records remain separate. This is not permission to give task workers expectations. More calls required if batch context/independence fails.

new_source_AI_reviews.basis: Reuse only exact-candidate, exact-selected-contract/rubric, raw-packet independent evidence; runtime changes may require separate review.

model_probe.basis: No standalone model probe required by source contracts. Authentication/status and boundary probes can be non-model. If a model availability probe is elected, reserve/count it; a failed launch consumes its case attempt and does not produce a free replacement.

receiving_execution.basis: Actual bounded builder-to-validator receiving invocation under CHG-003. It may serve an otherwise scheduled validator case only when exact task/input/phase/identity/conditions genuinely match and frozen cross-coverage is declared; a prepared handoff or static inspection cannot satisfy it.

controls.additional_call_count: Unresolved; never assume zero if authentic retained compatible bundles are absent.

controls.reuse_rule: Already generated authentic evidence may support a case only with matching requirements and immutable source/run provenance. Model attempts to generate missing bundles count; fabricated control receipts are forbidden.

engineering.basis: Root can implement locally without another delegated author. The approved proposal requires independent review of owned-process/result integration; a new review after meaningful implementation changes consumes a call under conservative accounting. Any further worker/reviewer/model-assisted diagnostic call must reserve its own slot.

actions: Continue authorized non-model prerequisite engineering and deterministic checks, but do not claim integration complete until demo incompatibility and launcher/importer/isolation evidence are resolved.
Preserve the original selected client/authentication/attempt/time approval. This analysis does not request repeated approval of those decisions.
Do not bind a campaign schedule that cannot cover declared requirements in 24. Do not request extra browser authorizations for unschedulable attempts.

Report the concrete coverage shortfall. A changed coverage scope or larger budget requires the relevant user decision; no silent omission, synthetic substitution, baseline exclusion, or deadline reset.
Retain native NOT_RUN and actual transfer NOT_OBSERVED until authentic execution evidence exists.
